meta.title: PPS parents urge Gov. Kotek, Sen. Drazan to intervene as school district considers closures
meta.author: KGW News
meta.description:
More than 300 parents have signed a letter calling on state leaders to step up and push Portland Public Schools to rethink possible closures.

Read more: https://www.kgw.com/article/news/education/portland-public-schools-closure-parents-letter-governor-kotek-drazan/283-c323ba33-e225-420f-8e86-68828a08aba8
